user.title: Connect to Con Edison Addon
user.description: Enter the internal addon URL. For Home Assistant addons, use the format: http://{addon-slug}:8000 (e.g. http://9a4bbad0-coned-scraper:8000). Find your addon slug in Settings > Add-ons > Con Edison > Info.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the addon. Please check the URL and ensure the addon is running.
